Candidate library search override is explicit; actual fresh guard load-command/dependency inspection and root runtime admission must precede any guard launch. Installed libraries are never rewritten.
standalone_guard_loader_candidate.success_meaning: Only18 existing synthetic validation assertions, no MooseApp instantiated; no dynamic-registration/observer-ABI or physical field acceptance.
